name: CI with gz-physics

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'  # weekly on Sunday

jobs:
  build_and_test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        cpp_std: [c++17, c++20]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout dart repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            build-essential cmake git libboost-all-dev libeigen3-dev \
            libgtest-dev libgz-physics-dev libgz-physics0-dev

      - name: Build dart
        run: |
          cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=${{ matrix.cpp_std }}
          cmake --build build -- -j$(nproc)
          sudo cmake --install build

      - name: Checkout gz-physics repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gazebosim/gz-physics
          ref: v0.9.0
          path: gz-physics
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Build gz-physics against dart
        run: |
          cmake -S gz-physics -B gz-physics/build \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
            -DGZ_PHYSICS_BUILD_TESTS=ON \
            -DGZ_PHYSICS_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF \
            -DGZ_PHYSICS_BUILD_DOCS=OFF \
            -DGZ_PHYSICS_BUILD_BENCHMARKS=OFF \
            -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/usr/local
          cmake --build gz-physics/build -- -j$(nproc)

      - name: Run dart tests
        run: |
          cd build
          ctest --output-on-failure

      - name: Run gz-physics tests
        run: |
          cd gz-physics/build
          ctest --output-on-failure
